seed: At Next defaults, with no switch touched: a right click anywhere on the timeline leaves the playhead where it was parked (the user, 2026-10-13). Park it at two seconds, right click the recording's clip near five seconds and choose Add Key at 0:02.00: the playhead has not moved and the key is at two seconds, so the same menu further along now offers Remove Key at 0:02.00. Split at Playhead from a right click near six seconds cuts at two. A right click on the clip's sound, the zoom bar, the title bar and the scrub bar leaves the playhead alone too, and a right click on the title picks it.

steps.choose: Add Title Page > More Styles > Stacked Stagger

steps.comment: Park the playhead at two seconds.
Right click the clip near five seconds and add a key: the row says where it goes, the playhead stays, the clip is picked.

steps.note: THE FIRST TEST: playhead parked at two seconds, a right click on the clip near five seconds, Add Key at 0:02.00: the playhead is still at two seconds and the clip is picked

steps.comment: The key is at two seconds: the clip's menu, right clicked near seven seconds, now offers to remove the key at 0:02.00.
Split at Playhead from a right click near six seconds cuts at the parked two seconds.
Piece 1 runs from the start to the cut at two seconds.

steps.note: THE SECOND TEST: a right click near six seconds, Split at Playhead: the cut is at the parked two seconds and the playhead has not moved

steps.comment: A right click on the second piece, far from the playhead, leaves it parked.
The clip's sound, the zoom bar and the scrub bar: none moves the playhead.
A right click on the title, not picked, picks it and leaves the playhead parked.

steps.note: THE THIRD TEST: a right click on the title bar picks the title, and the playhead is still at two seconds
